BT_OUT.SECTION_DESC: Stream Volumio playback to a Bluetooth speaker or amplifier. Click 'Scan for devices', wait a few seconds, then pick your device from the list below. Enable and Save.
BT_OUT.NOTICE_DOC: Known limitations - follow these to avoid losing sound.
BT_OUT.NOTICE_TEXT: 1) STOP playback before switching devices here or powering off the speaker/amp. 2) If there is no sound after switching devices, reboot Volumio (System -> Reboot). 3) After a reboot, wait ~15s before playing, or the first track may stutter.
BT_OUT.SCAN_DOC: Looks for nearby Bluetooth devices (~8s). Close and re-open this settings page afterwards to see them in the device list below.
BT_OUT.ENABLE_DOC: Pairs/connects to the selected device and adds it as an MPD output alongside your normal output.
BT_OUT.MAC_DOC: Pick a discovered device. If pairing requires a PIN on the device itself, confirm it there when prompted.
BT_OUT.NAME: Device name
BT_OUT.NAME_DOC: Filled in automatically from the selected device.
